title: A remote machine's records reach R&D's store
request: The owner's standing rule: capture every agent process for training; cloud sessions on the owner's SSH machine kept their records there.
plan: every DCLab Code exports its session list and records behind its token
a connected machine's records are copied here after each Connect and on a click, only what changed
R&D's store keeps the sessions on that machine's R&D as the person's

decisions.decision: copy through the existing tunnel over DCLab Code's own API, not rsync
decisions.why: no remote path or tool to know; the remote app knows its own home

decisions.decision: keep a remote session when it worked in that machine's R&D folder, its path compared as written
decisions.why: resolving a remote path on this Mac would read this Mac's folders

decisions.decision: attachments and settings are never copied
decisions.why: the store counts images only and never keeps settings

change: dclab-code server/remote.js (copyRecords, remoteDir), server/app.js (GET /api/records/export and /records/file/<name>, POST /api/remotes/records, a copy after each Connect, one copy at a time), web/app.js (Copy records). R&D dclab_rnd/store/keepers/dclab_code.py (remote_homes, _inside_there), dclab_rnd/store/sets/dclab_code.py (remote records are the person's), tests.

findings.defect: the copy after Connect and a click could write the same files at once
findings.scenario: Connect, then Copy records before the first copy ends
findings.cause: two copies of one machine ran together
findings.fix: one copy per machine at a time
findings.test: server test copies twice; the second copies nothing

findings.defect: a machine reporting / as its R&D folder would keep every session there
findings.fix: an R&D folder needs at least two parts

findings.defect: a lookalike or .. path could pass as inside R&D
findings.scenario: a lookalike folder (R&Dx beside R&D) and a path that leaves R&D through ..
findings.cause: a text prefix compare would accept them

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 120 of 120; R&D test_store_dclab_code and its sets: 17 of 17; the copied record equals the remote's byte for byte

outcome: Sessions run on the person's own server are kept for training like the ones on their Mac.
lessons: When a feature moves work to another machine, move its records with it, or the training data has a hole.
risks: not run against a real server yet
a record over 512 MB is skipped and said
